description: Enable or disable the per-job Task Checklist worker surface. The toggle gates WORKER visibility only (authoring keeps working while off); disabling hides every published checklist from workers and requires confirmDisable. Receipt-backed. Requires job_checklists:write.

confirmDisable.description: Required when enabled=false: acknowledges workers lose the surface.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_job_checklists_set_enabled
